author: RIP_Avicus
body:
Hey guys,
Me and my friends are thinking of making a Nebula map, but we need some inspiration.
What do you guys like to see in a Nebula map, and what don't you like to see?
Any help or ideas would be greatly appreciated.
Thanks :D

replies.author: HentieSenpai
replies.body:
We don't want to see a laggy map.
We want a decent amount of space to PVP.

replies.author: lactify
replies.body: Be creative, think out of the ordinary. Something players will love. Are you going to make it easy or challenging? Hope this will help you on the start to your Map Creation journey. :)

replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body: Make sure each map is fairly original. Try to have a staple for each map.like Quintus is known for kill farming, venomous tdm is known for fast PvP. Just try to have something different in it.

replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Gameplay is always in the first place. You should make your map gameplay wised, for example,for a Capture The Wool map, put bedrock before the wool to stop tunnelers.
If your map is gameplay wised, then work on the aesthetics and the design. Make is eye pleasing, you want a player to spawn and say, what a beautiful map! And then he wants to play it.
But always remember, Gameplay  is more important then aesthetics. 
Good luck with your map, and I hoped it helped you.
